Website Design & Development Intern (Wix)
Beyond the Game Health | Remote | Part-Time Internship
Commitment: Minimum 15 hours per week
Compensation: Unpaid internship; academic credit may be available through an eligible educational institution
Location: Remote (United States)About Beyond the Game Health
Beyond the Game Health (BTGH) is a sports and healthcare platform connecting athletes, healthcare organizations, brands, and communities to drive meaningful health engagement and impact.
Through athlete-led health campaigns, strategic partnerships, community activations, events, and storytelling, BTGH leverages the influence of sports to advance health education, awareness, and access.
We are seeking a creative, detail-oriented, and technically capable Website Design & Development Intern with hands-on Wix experience to support the continued development and optimization of our digital presence.Position Overview
The Website Design & Development Intern will work closely with our Founder & CEO and creative marketing team to enhance the design, functionality, organization, and overall user experience of the Beyond the Game Health website.
This role is ideal for a student interested in website development, UX/UI design, digital marketing, or creative technology who wants practical experience supporting a growing sports and healthcare brand.
We are looking for someone who can take initiative, offer creative recommendations, and translate ideas into polished, professional website experiences.Key Responsibilities
Website Design & Development

- Maintain, update, and enhance the company website using Wix or Wix Studio.
- Design and build visually compelling webpages and landing pages.
- Improve website navigation, layout, responsiveness, and user experience.
- Ensure consistent branding, typography, imagery, and design across all pages.
- Optimize the website for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
- Troubleshoot broken links, formatting issues, and basic website functionality.
- Recommend improvements that elevate the website's overall professional appearance.
Content Management & Digital Marketing

- Upload and organize website content, including blogs, videos, photos, press coverage, and company announcements.
- Develop dedicated pages for athlete partnerships, health campaigns, sponsorship opportunities, and upcoming events.
- Support the integration of video content, media features, and company accomplishments.
- Collaborate with marketing and creative team members to ensure website content remains accurate and current.
- Create and update contact forms, inquiry forms, and calls to action.
- Support website search engine optimization (SEO), including page titles, descriptions, image optimization, and keywords.
Website Strategy & Performance

- Evaluate existing website pages and identify opportunities for improvement.
- Assist with website analytics and visitor engagement tracking.
- Improve the user journey for potential sponsors, healthcare partners, athletes, and community organizations.
- Help create a more streamlined experience for partnership inquiries and event registrations.
- Research and recommend relevant Wix integrations, applications, and website enhancements.
- Maintain organized records of website updates and development priorities.
Team Collaboration & Project Management

- Participate in weekly team meetings and project check-ins.
- Collaborate with the creative marketing, social media, and business development teams.
- Track assignments, deliverables, and deadlines using ClickUp.
- Communicate progress, challenges, and recommendations proactively.
- Manage assigned projects independently while meeting established deadlines.Required Qualifications

- Current student or recent graduate studying Web Design, Web Development, Graphic Design, Digital Media, Computer Science, Marketing, or a related field.
- Demonstrated hands-on experience with Wix or Wix Studio.
- Understanding of website design principles, mobile responsiveness, and user experience.
- Strong visual design skills and attention to detail.
- Ability to create professional, polished webpages with minimal supervision.
- Strong organizational, communication, and time-management skills.
- Ability to manage multiple assignments and meet deadlines.
- Willingness to collaborate in a remote team environment.Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with Wix CMS, Wix Forms, Wix Events, or Wix integrations.
- Familiarity with Figma, Canva, Adobe Creative Cloud, or similar design tools.
- Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, or JavaScript.
- Understanding of SEO and Google Analytics.
- Experience creating event, campaign, or sponsorship landing pages.
- Familiarity with video embedding, multimedia content, and digital storytelling.
- Interest in sports, healthcare, entertainment, or community engagement.What You'll Gain

- Practical experience managing and improving a live business website.
- Portfolio-worthy web design and development projects.
- Exposure to sports marketing, healthcare partnerships, athlete engagement, and event production.
- Opportunities to collaborate directly with executive leadership and a cross-functional creative team.
- Experience translating business goals into digital design solutions.
- Potential academic credit, subject to school approval.How to Apply
Interested candidates should submit:

- A current resume.
- A portfolio or links to websites they have designed or maintained, preferably using Wix.
- A brief description of their experience with Wix or Wix Studio.
- Their weekly availability and anticipated internship duration.
Please note: This is an unpaid educational internship opportunity. Candidates should confirm any academic credit requirements with their institution.

- Website: www.beyondthegamehealth.com
fit_why: Wix website design role, not software engineering; unpaid part-time

About Us

Info-Tech Research Group delivers impartial, highly pertinent IT research, enabling CIOs and IT leaders to make well-informed, strategic decisions. We are currently serving over 30,000 professionals and collaborate with IT teams, equipping them with actionable tools and expert guidance to drive measurable results and enhance technology initiatives and organizational processes.

Why join us?



- We pride ourselves on consistent year-over-year growth.
- We are ranked among the Top 3 on LinkedIn’s Top Companies List in Canada.
- We foster a growth-focused, entrepreneurial culture with unlimited opportunities for professional growth and development.
- We provide financial support for professional development and training.

About The Role

The Software Developer Co-Op writes front-end and back-end code that drives ITRG products. In this role, the student will gain hands-on experience working within a product development team, contributing to production code, and learning from Senior Developers to strengthen their technical and professional skills.

Key Tasks



- Completes development coding and testing using Ruby on Rails.
- Participates in sprint and feature planning sessions; analyzes product vendor requirements and helps design technical solutions.
- Participates in code reviews to ensure code quality, maintainability, and adherence to development standards.

Education And Experience

- Some programming experience through academic, personal, or hobby projects

Skills



- Software Development: Ability to program in at least one language (experience with Ruby on Rails is not required).
- Web Development: Basic familiarity with web development concepts and practices.
- Collaboration: Ability to work effectively within project teams and contribute to shared goals.
- Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills to interact with stakeholders and project owners.
- Problem Solving: Ability to analyze business requirements and develop appropriate technical solutions.

Location

We have offices in both London and Toronto, Ontario (Remote/Hybrid Based on Location)



- We ask all applicants to please include an (unofficial) transcript with their resume*

Info-Tech Research Group of companies is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected status or characteristics including Minority/Female/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity/Disability/Veteran and are pleased to consider all qualified applicants. To that end, upon request, ITRG will ensure, to the extent possible, that accommodations be made available to applicants through the recruitment and hiring process.

Description & Requirements

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

AI Engineer Intern – Creative Innovations (Character Pipelines)

Electronic Arts creates next-level entertainment experiences that inspire players and fans around the world. Here, everyone is part of the story. Part of a community that connects across the globe. A place where creativity thrives, new perspectives are invited, and ideas matter. A team where everyone makes play happen.

Role Overview

The Creative Innovations team at Electronic Arts develops core pipeline technologies that power character deformation, facial rigging, and digital likeness across global franchises. As an AI Engineer Intern embedded with our character pipeline group, you will focus on developing, prototyping, and integrating machine learning models and neural networks directly into production animation workflows. You will collaborate with software engineers, technical artists, and AI scientists to build practical, intelligent tools that automate complex character deformation and enhance artist workflows.

What You Will Do

You will design, train, and evaluate machine learning models tailored for 3D character deformation and automated facial performance. Rather than working solely on ingestion infrastructure, you will write application code and train neural networks using both raw 3D capture data that requires cleaning and high-fidelity, artist-tuned reference assets. You will build and refine models that predict blendshapes, create mesh deformations, and automate landmark tracking, ensuring that model predictions align with artist intent and production quality standards.

In addition to core model development, you will integrate these AI systems into our modern character pipeline stack. You will write clean, production-quality Python code, using USD schemas to connect training environments with digital content creation software such as Autodesk Maya and Houdini. You will package and deploy your code and model environments using Docker to ensure execution across local workstations and cloud platforms (such as Amazon Web Services services). You will also use and experiment with AI developer agents to accelerate coding, testing, and pipeline automation tasks.

What You Bring



- You are enrolled in a bachelors degree program in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computer Graphics, or a related technical discipline.
- You have practical programming skills in Python and a solid conceptual and applied foundation in machine learning, specifically around deep learning and neural network architectures.
- Experience training, evaluating, and fine-tuning models using frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow is necessary , along with a practical approach to handling both noisy raw data and curated datasets.
- You have a working knowledge of fundamental 3D geometry concepts, linear algebra, and coordinate transformations as they apply to mesh topology and deformation.
- Practical experience containerizing applications with Docker and collaborating through Git and modern version control platforms is required.
- Familiarity with USD, digital content creation APIs in Maya or Houdini, model inference optimization, or the effective prompting and use of AI coding agents will help you ramp up quickly.
- Most importantly, you bring clear technical communication and a genuine enthusiasm for applying artificial intelligence to creative character technology.

You must be available for a full-time paid internship in the summer of 2027.

At this time, we are considering Undergrad students who will be enrolled in an accredited degree program in the summer of 2027, slated to graduate no earlier than December 2027. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in Canada on a full-time basis during the 16-week internship. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

Please ensure that your graduation date is visible on your resume.

Pay Transparency - North America



-  British Columbia (depending on location e.g. Vancouver vs. Victoria) *$65,000 - $70,000 CAD

Pay is just one part of the overall compensation at EA.

About Electronic Arts

We’re proud to have an extensive portfolio of games and experiences, locations around the world, and opportunities across EA. We value adaptability, resilience, creativity, and curiosity. From leadership that brings out your potential, to creating space for learning and experimenting, we empower you to do great work and pursue opportunities for growth.

We adopt a holistic approach to our benefits programs, emphasizing physical, emotional, financial, career, and community wellness to support a balanced life. Our packages are tailored to meet local needs and may include healthcare coverage, mental well-being support, retirement savings, paid time off, family leaves, complimentary games, and more. We nurture environments where our teams can always bring their best to what they do.

Electronic Arts is an equal opportunity employer. All employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, national origin, ancestry, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, genetic information, religion, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, marital status, family status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will also consider employment qualified applicants with criminal records in accordance with applicable law. EA also makes workplace accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities as required by applicable law.
fit_why: Requires embedded-adjacent character pipeline, Maya/Houdini, PyTorch, 2027 timing

AI Infrastructure Datacenter Design Engineer Intern 
 
 Position Summary 
 The AI Infrastructure Datacenter Design Engineer Intern supports the engineering team in basic data hall design, documentation, and infrastructure planning activities while gaining hands-on experience in AI and hyperscale data center environments. This role is designed for students or recent graduates looking to develop foundational knowledge in datacenter infrastructure, AutoCAD drafting, rack layouts, cabling standards, and engineering project coordination under the guidance of senior engineers. 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 ● Assist in creating and updating AutoCAD drawings, rack elevations, cabinet layouts, and structured cabling documentation.
● Support data hall design documentation, asset tracking, and revision management activities.
● Assist engineering teams with infrastructure inventory validation and basic capacity tracking.
● Help maintain design standards, templates, and project documentation repositories.
● Participate in engineering reviews, design walkthroughs, and quality assurance activities.
● Coordinate with cross-functional teams to gather project inputs and update design records.
● Support preparation of project reports, spreadsheets, diagrams, and technical documentation.
● Learn data center infrastructure concepts including power, cooling, cabling, rack configurations, and AI cluster environments.
● Follow established operational procedures, engineering standards, and safety requirements.
● Assist with administrative and project coordination tasks related to infrastructure deployment activities. 
 
 Learning Opportunities 
 ● Exposure to AI and hyperscale data center infrastructure environments.
● Hands-on experience with AutoCAD and infrastructure design tools.
● Understanding of structured cabling, rack layouts, and datacenter operational workflows.
● Participation in real-world engineering and infrastructure deployment projects.
● Mentorship from senior engineering and infrastructure professionals.
● Exposure to project management, documentation control, and engineering lifecycle processes. 
 
 Scope & Complexity 
 ● Works on low-complexity assignments with clearly defined objectives and supervision.
● Primarily focused on learning, documentation support, and foundational engineering tasks.
● Limited independent decision-making authority.
● Collaborates closely with engineering, operations, and project teams. 
 
 Requirements 
 ● Currently pursuing or recently completed an Associate or Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field.
● Basic understanding of datacenter or IT infrastructure concepts preferred.
● Familiarity with AutoCAD, Visio, or similar drafting/documentation tools is a plus.
● Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools including Excel, PowerPoint, and Word.
● Strong attention to detail, organization, and communication skills.
● Ability to learn quickly and work in a collaborative team environment.
● Interest in AI infrastructure, data centers, networking, or cloud technologies preferred. 

 Salary Range 
$15.71 - $24.81 USD (Hourly) 
• Please note that the salary information provided herein is base pay only (gross); it does not include other forms of compensation which may or may not apply to this specific position, namely, performance-based bonuses, benefits-related payments, or other general incentives - none of which are guaranteed, may be subject to specific eligibility requirements, and are wholly within the discretion of Astreya to remit. 
• Further, the salary information noted above is a range that consists of a minimum and maximum rate of pay for this specific position. Where an applicant or employee is placed on this range will depend and be contingent on objective, documented work-related considerations like education, experience, certifications, licenses, preferred qualifications, among other factors.
fit_why: Datacenter CAD drafting and infrastructure ops; no software engineering work
